description: This file defines the SelectLanguageForm class, which provides a language selection form for Drupal's installer. It includes methods for building the form with language options, handling form submission, and references external classes and functions related to language management, HTTP requests, and form handling.

classes.name: SelectLanguageForm
classes.description: Provides a form for selecting a language during Drupal installation, with options based on standard languages and available translation files.

methods.name: getFormId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the form.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the language selection form with options based on available translations and browser language detection.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission by updating the form build info with the selected language code.
